pair.title: Pair {name}
pair.description: Paste this sensor's pair code. In the LumeAir app, go to Settings › Home Assistant and tap Copy pair code next to the sensor.

data_description.pair_code: The pair code gives full access to the sensor. Home Assistant only reads it, on your home network.

user.title: Add a LumeAir sensor
user.description: Paste the sensor's pair code. In the LumeAir app, go to Settings › Home Assistant and tap Copy pair code next to the sensor.

reauth_confirm.title: Pair {name} again
reauth_confirm.description: {name} no longer accepts the pair code Home Assistant has, usually because it was set up again. Paste its current pair code from the LumeAir app.

error.invalid_code: That isn't a LumeAir pair code. Copy it again from the app.
error.wrong_sensor: That pair code is for a different sensor.
error.invalid_auth: The sensor didn't accept this pair code. Copy the current one from the app.
error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach the sensor. Check that it's plugged in and on the same network as Home Assistant.

invalid_auth.message: The sensor no longer accepts its pair code.

update_no_release.message: There's no firmware release for this sensor right now.

update_refused_not_newer.message: The sensor already runs this version or a newer one.

update_refused_busy.message: The sensor is already installing an update.

update_refused_on_trial.message: The sensor was just updated and is checking that the new version works. Try again in a few minutes.

update_refused_bad_signature.message: The sensor refused this release: it isn't signed for this sensor.

update_refused_no_memory.message: The sensor couldn't start the update. Restart it and try again.

update_refused_unsupported.message: This sensor's firmware is too old to update over Wi-Fi. Update it from the LumeAir app.

update_refused.message: The sensor didn't start the update: {reason}

update_failed.message: The update failed ({reason}). The sensor is still on its earlier version.

update_timeout.message: The update didn't finish in time. The sensor stays on its earlier version if it didn't install.

update_not_installed.message: The sensor restarted but isn't running {version}. If the new version didn't work, the sensor went back to the earlier one.
